Codex review: needs maintainer review before merge. _Reviewed September 2, 2026, 9:15 AM ET / 13:15 UTC._ # ClawSweeper review ## What this changes This PR moves automatic SQLite session maintenance out of normal session-entry writes into a coalesced, handle-bound deferred owner, with targeted candidate queries and lifecycle-race coverage. ## Regression provenance Possible regression — probable (reproduction; reviewed change). No predecessor PR is attributed. ## Merge readiness ⚠️ **Ready for maintainer review - 4 items remain** Keep open. The introduced patch is a coherent owner-boundary repair with no concrete correctness finding from source review, and current main does not contain it. Its changed automatic-cleanup timing and protected maintainer status require session-storage owner review before merge. **Priority:** P1 **Reviewed head:** `a2c9c7ae4886980692f47e163a064291297e3d71` **Owner decision:** Required. See [Decision needed](#decision-needed). ## Review scores | Measure | Result | What it means | |---|---|---| | **Overall readiness** | 🐚 platinum hermit **(4/6)** | The patch has a sound owner boundary and focused regressions, with owner acceptance of deferred retention timing still required. | | **Proof confidence** | 🌊 off-meta tidepool | Not applicable: The mandatory external-contributor proof gate does not apply to this member-authored PR; its body describes after-fix runtime measurements and boundary tests, but this read-only review did not execute them. | | **Patch quality** | 🐚 platinum hermit **(4/6)** | No actionable review findings were identified. | ## Verification | Check | Result | Evidence | |---|---|---| | **Real behavior** | Not applicable | Not applicable: The mandatory external-contributor proof gate does not apply to this member-authored PR; its body describes after-fix runtime measurements and boundary tests, but this read-only review did not execute them. | | **Evidence reviewed** | 6 items | Entry-write boundary: The entry accessor now commits the entry and schedules maintenance afterward, rather than constructing a maintenance plan within the write transaction.
Deferred lifecycle fence: The new per-store owner verifies that it still owns the exact open database handle before planning and again during finalization; subsequent writes advance a generation for a fresh pass.
Targeted maintenance planning: Maintenance builds a lightweight key projection, loads only age/cap candidates, then reloads exact selected entries before archive or removal planning. | | **Findings** | None | None. | | **Security** | None | None. | ## How this fits together Channel ingress records session metadata and route state before dispatching a turn. The session-maintenance subsystem later archives or removes stale entries and their unreferenced transcript state. ```mermaid flowchart LR A[Inbound channel message] --> B[Session metadata and route write] B --> C[Deferred maintenance owner] C --> D[Targeted candidate selection] D --> E[Lifecycle revalidation] E --> F[Archive or remove stale state] B --> G[Turn dispatch] ``` ## Decision needed | Question | Recommendation | |---|---| | Should normal SQLite session-entry writes adopt eventual, process-local automatic maintenance while explicit cleanup remains synchronous? | **Accept deferred automatic cleanup:** Land the handle-bound coalesced owner after normal exact-head CI, accepting that routine writes no longer wait for cleanup completion. | Why: This changes the timing of retention work on persisted session state without adding a schema or configuration contract; source review supports the design, but accepting that operational tradeoff requires owner intent. ## Before merge - [ ] **Resolve merge risk (P1)** - Automatic cleanup now has eventual rather than write-complete timing; a process or handle lifecycle change can defer retention work until a later eligible write. - [ ] **Resolve merge risk (P1)** - Production code grows by 259 net lines for a bug fix; the coalesced owner and exact-handle fence are source-justified, but storage-owner review should confirm that this complexity is warranted. - [ ] **Complete next step (P2)** - Obtain session-storage owner acceptance of deferred automatic-cleanup timing, then complete exact-head CI before merge.
Agent review details ### Security None. ### PR surface Source +259, Tests +277. Total +536 across 16 files.
View PR surface stats | Area | Files | Added | Removed | Net | |---|---:|---:|---:|---:| | Source | 5 | 464 | 205 | +259 | | Tests | 11 | 349 | 72 | +277 | | Docs | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | | Config | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | | Generated | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | | Other | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | | **Total** | **16** | **813** | **277** | **+536** |
### Review metrics | Metric | Value | Why it matters | |---|---|---| | **Production versus tests** | production +259, tests +277 | The patch replaces synchronous maintenance with a new process-local owner and candidate-query boundary, so its production growth merits storage-owner review. | ### Stored data model Persistent data-model change detected: `unknown-data-model-change: src/config/sessions/session-accessor.sqlite-entry.ts`. Confirm migration or upgrade compatibility proof before merge. ### Merge-risk options **Maintainer options:** 1. **Accept the deferred retention contract (recommended)** Have a session-storage owner confirm that ordinary writes may return before automatic pruning or archival completes, then rely on exact-head CI for the implementation gate. 2. **Pause for a different lifecycle design** Do not merge if automatic cleanup must survive a handle or process transition without waiting for another eligible write. ### Technical review Best possible solution: Retain the handle-bound, coalesced maintenance owner if a session-storage owner accepts eventual automatic cleanup on ordinary writes; preserve explicit cleanup’s synchronous contract and merge only after exact-head CI succeeds. Do we have a high-confidence way to reproduce the issue? Yes, source-reproducible: seed an unprotected stale session entry and send a channel inbound event; current main remains on the pre-PR entry-maintenance path, while the added boundary test models dispatch-before-cleanup. Is this the best way to solve the issue? Yes, subject to the stated lifecycle decision: moving maintenance to the post-commit owner addresses the implicated serialized-write boundary while retaining exact-entry and transcript-state revalidation before deletion. AGENTS.md: found and applied where relevant. ([`src/config/sessions/session-accessor.sqlite-maintenance-kick.ts:67`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/a2c9c7ae4886980692f47e163a064291297e3d71/src/config/sessions/session-accessor.sqlite-maintenance-kick.ts#L67), [a2c9c7ae4886](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/a2c9c7ae4886980692f47e163a064291297e3d71)) - **Targeted maintenance planning:** Maintenance builds a lightweight key projection, loads only age/cap candidates, then reloads exact selected entries before archive or removal planning. ([`src/config/sessions/session-accessor.sqlite-maintenance.ts:361`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/a2c9c7ae4886980692f47e163a064291297e3d71/src/config/sessions/session-accessor.sqlite-maintenance.ts#L361), [a2c9c7ae4886](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/a2c9c7ae4886980692f47e163a064291297e3d71)) - **Boundary regression coverage:** The added published Plugin SDK test verifies dispatch observes the stale entry before asynchronous cleanup removes it. ([`src/plugin-sdk/channel-inbound.test.ts:108`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/a2c9c7ae4886980692f47e163a064291297e3d71/src/plugin-sdk/channel-inbound.test.ts#L108), [a2c9c7ae4886](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/a2c9c7ae4886980692f47e163a064291297e3d71)) - **Current-main and release provenance:** The PR head is not an ancestor of fetched current main, while its base is; the latest release v2026.8.2 also does not contain the head. A base-to-current-main diff showed no changes to the modified entry-maintenance files. ([abb565ea5f9f](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/abb565ea5f9feacd89a571247adb96a799a0e3ce)) - **Feature history:** Recent maintenance history includes the prior merged session-retention repair by Ayaan Zaidi, establishing existing area involvement beyond this PR. Owner acceptance for the ClawSweeper before-merge items:

- I accept eventual, process-local automatic maintenance after normal entry writes. Explicit cleanup remains synchronous.
- I accept the +259 production-line owner because it contains one coalesced per-store lifecycle, indexed candidate selection, fresh reruns, and exact-handle fencing. There is no schema, sidecar, freshness poll, or second cache.
- Exact-head Autoreview P0 and required CI are green on `a2c9c7ae4886980692f47e163a064291297e3d71`.

Thanks @obviyus!

**Proof:** Published channel ingress dispatched before automatic maintenance on a large SQLite session store, then cleanup completed.

- **Bug:** Discord and Telegram ingress paid repeated full-store maintenance work before turn dispatch.
- **Fix:** One handle-bound per-store owner now coalesces maintenance after writes, selects indexed candidates, reruns fresh after concurrent writes, and skips only changed cleanup entries.

| Before | After |
| --- | --- |
| 537 MB store: channel ingress averaged 1,864 ms with two full entry materializations per call | 167 MB final runtime: channel ingress averaged 5.44 ms with zero full entry materializations; cleanup completed 5/5 |
